function normName(s) {
  return (s == null ? '' : String(s))
    .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')   // убрать диакритику
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[.'\u2019]/g, ' ')                         // точки/апострофы -> пробел
    .replace(/\b(san|sant|santa|santo|s)\b/g, 's')      // San/Sant'/Santa/S. -> s
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function resolveLocation(neighborhoodRaw) {
  const key = normName(neighborhoodRaw);
  if (!key) return { neighborhood: '', municipio: '', urban_zone: '' };
  const hit = ROME_QUARTERS[key];
  if (hit) return { neighborhood: hit[0], municipio: hit[1], urban_zone: hit[2] };
  // нет в справочнике — отдаём распознанное моделью, без municipio/urban_zone
  return { neighborhood: String(neighborhoodRaw || '').trim(), municipio: '', urban_zone: '' };
}


const e = $("Has Event ID?").item.json;
const loc = e.location || {};

let enriched = {};
let txt = "";
try {
  const enrichNode = $("Enrich Location").item.json;
  txt = enrichNode.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "";
  if (txt) {
    const cleanTxt = txt.replace(/```json/gi, "").replace(/```/g, "").trim();
    enriched = JSON.parse(cleanTxt);
  }
} catch (_) {}

// Resolve location using dictionary
const locResolved = resolveLocation(enriched.neighborhood || "");

let driveUrl = "";
try {
  const uploaded = $("Upload to Drive").item?.json || {};
  if (uploaded.id) driveUrl = "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=" + uploaded.id;
} catch (_) {}

const isoDate = e.utcStartDate || "";
const start_date = isoDate.slice(0, 10);
let end_date = start_date;

const dur = (e.duration == null ? "" : String(e.duration)).toLowerCase();
if (start_date && dur && /day/.test(dur)) {
  const m = dur.match(/(\d+)\s*day/);
  const days = m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
  if (Number.isFinite(days) && days > 0) {
    const startMs = Date.parse(isoDate);
    if (!Number.isNaN(startMs)) {
      end_date = new Date(startMs + days * 86400 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
  }
}

const organizers = Array.isArray(e.organizators) ? e.organizators : [];
const pageName = (organizers[0] && organizers[0].name) || (e.organizedBy || "").replace(/^Event by\s*/, "") || "";

const record = {
  post_id:           e.id || e.eventId || "",
  post_link:         e.url || "",
  page_name:         pageName,
  post_date:         isoDate,
  event_location:    loc.name || loc.streetAddress || loc.city || "",
  start_date:        start_date,
  end_date:          end_date,
  time:              isoDate.slice(11, 16),
  city:              loc.city || "Roma",
  municipio:         locResolved.municipio,
  urban_zone:        locResolved.urban_zone,
  neighborhood:      locResolved.neighborhood,
  event_description: e.name || "",
  full_post_text:    e.description || "",
  image_url:         driveUrl || e.imageUrl || "",
  event_cost:        e.paidContent ? "paid" : "free"
};

const raw = JSON.stringify(record);
const safe = raw.replace(/[Ā-]/g,
  c => "\\u" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4, "0")
);

return { json: { event_json: JSON.stringify(safe), neighborhood: locResolved.neighborhood, ai_raw: txt, ai_parsed: enriched } };
